visuals.caption_fil: Ang mga benepisyo ay hindi awtomatiko — nakasalalay ito sa tamang rehistrasyon sa local health board.
visuals.caption_en: Benefits aren't automatic — they depend on proper registration with the local health board.
visuals.alt_text_fil: Dayagram ng daloy na may apat na hakbang: Magrehistro sa local health board, Susuriin ang aplikasyon at board resolution, Certificate ng akreditasyon ibinigay, at Eligible na sa benepisyo.
visuals.alt_text_en: Flow diagram with four steps: Register with the local health board, Application reviewed and board resolution, Accreditation certificate issued, and Eligible for benefits.
